description: Phase 38 sweep contract defining the scientific rules for S16 Epoch-cap sweep

factor_definition.note: max_epochs is a CEILING, not a guaranteed budget

frozen_configuration.description: All fields below are frozen and must NOT differ between E50 and E100

only_max_epochs_differs.description: Only max_epochs may differ between E50 and E100

selection_rules.exact_tie_rule: E50 wins on exact RMSE tie
selection_rules.no_runtime_override: Runtime does not override RMSE comparison

prefix_equivalence.description: Under scheduler=None and full reproducibility, E50 and E100 should share identical trajectories before epoch 50

e50_cap_binding.description: Classify whether E50 cap is binding
e50_cap_binding.REACHED_CAP_BEST_EARLY: E50 hit cap but BEST was early
e50_cap_binding.REACHED_CAP_BEST_NEAR_BOUNDARY: E50 hit cap and BEST was near boundary
e50_cap_binding.REACHED_CAP_BEST_AT_BOUNDARY: E50 hit cap and BEST was at boundary

e100_budget_utilization.description: Classify how much of E100 extra budget was used
e100_budget_utilization.NO_EXTRA_BUDGET_USED: E100 early-stopped at or before epoch 50

post50_improvement.description: Analyze whether E100 found new BEST after epoch 50
post50_improvement.POST50_NOT_OBSERVED: E100 did not train past epoch 50
post50_improvement.POST50_NO_NEW_GLOBAL_BEST: E100 trained past 50 but found no new global BEST
post50_improvement.POST50_NEW_GLOBAL_BEST: E100 found new global BEST after epoch 50

test_policy.note: Test set must not be accessed during Phase 38

prohibited_actions: E100 continuation from E50 BEST checkpoint

phase39_handoff.note: Phase 39 will use S16 winner's max_epochs setting
